## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for elevation above sea level in metres on a [`GeoCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-GeoCoordinates.md) point.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a frame-relative vertical bound on an overlay (use [`gmeow:overlayLowerBound`](gmeow-overlayLowerBound.md) / [`gmeow:overlayUpperBound`](gmeow-overlayUpperBound.md) with a [`ScalarQuantity`](../classes/gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md)) and avoid for celestial epoch.

### How to use

- Add [`gmeow:elevation`](gmeow-elevation.md) alongside [`gmeow:latitude`](gmeow-latitude.md) / [`gmeow:longitude`](gmeow-longitude.md); for explicit vertical datums use the altitude/depth reference frames.

### Examples

- ex:pt [`gmeow:elevation`](gmeow-elevation.md) 47.0.
